releaseNotes:
• Fix: Stop Dance, Fight & Pre-Scene False Skips — rebuilt CLIP prompts to exclude hugging and explicitly contrast dancing, fighting, and close talking; capped dark brightness gain at 1.85x; and prevented double-counting one cached CLIP score on neededHits=2.
• Fix: Zero Post-Scene Trailing Loop — clears AudioIntimateDetector ring buffer (resetWindow) after each +10s skip and waits 1.15s shielded + 250ms post-hide settle so ExoPlayer finishes buffering the seeked chunk before re-scanning.
